clauses.anchor: Expected behaviour, first bullet: a payload on a derelict payload conveyor stays on it through a save; team conveyors keep passing and keeping payloads
Expected behaviour, second bullet: saves load with any number of queued build plans and keep every plan
Expected behaviour, third bullet: carried derelict blocks can be set down inside a core's protected area; own-team and far derelict drops keep working; other teams' blocks stay excluded
Context, last paragraph: changes stay inside mindustry/core/src and mindustry/server/src, which the server build compiles
clauses.note: enforced only through the offline build of those source roots
